config.title: Settings
config.intro: The files stay the main way to configure LangBrain: .env, configurazione.toml and the files of the nodes you installed. This page edits those same files for you when you prefer a form: comments and order are kept, and the previous version of each file is saved as .bak.
config.admin_note: Reading is open to every role; saving needs the administrator key.
config.file_missing: {name} does not exist yet: it is created when you save.
config.confirm_restore: Put back the previous version of the files (the one before your last save)?
config.restart_needed: Restart the API for these to take effect: {list}
config.key_change_warn: You are changing an API key. The key you typed at the top of this page stops working once saved: use the new one afterwards. Continue?
config.secret_placeholder: type a new value to replace it
config.not_in_file: not in the file: the default applies
config.not_editable_note: Devices (effectors) and external actors have a richer structure: edit them in the files.
config.hlp_env_default_provider: Provider used for model calls: google_studio, openrouter, mistral, anthropic, local or auto.
config.hlp_env_mao_fallback: Empty: configurazione.toml decides. 0 or 1 here overrides the file (try the other providers when one fails).
config.hlp_env_mao_timeout_seconds: HTTP timeout of model calls, in seconds.
config.hlp_env_mao_max_tokens_minimo: Output tokens to start with; reasoning models spend many before answering.
config.hlp_env_mao_max_tokens_limite: Upper limit when a truncated answer makes the call double the tokens.
config.hlp_env_gemini_api_key: Key of Google AI Studio. Write-only: it is never shown again.
config.hlp_env_google_base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of Google AI Studio.
config.hlp_env_mistral_api_key: Mistral key, also used by Mistral OCR. Write-only.
config.hlp_env_anthropic_base_url: OpenAI-compatible address of the Anthropic API.
config.hlp_env_local_model: Name of the model served locally.
config.hlp_env_local_model_base_url: Address of the local OpenAI-compatible server.
config.hlp_env_local_model_docker_base_url: Address used only by the Docker container to reach the model on the host.
config.hlp_env_local_api_key: Key of the local server, if it asks for one. Write-only.
config.hlp_env_api_key_medico_di_guardia: Operator key: graph cycles, device commands, HITL decisions. Write-only here.
config.hlp_env_api_key_primario: Administrator key: everything, including this page. Write-only here.
config.hlp_env_api_key: Legacy single key: counts as administrator. Write-only here.
config.hlp_env_flag_ttl_minutes: Minutes a control flag lasts before it expires.
config.hlp_config_general_language: Language of the default prompts, the API messages and the web pages.
config.hlp_config_llm_fallback: Off: a provider error stops the graph and hands over to the operator. On: the other providers are tried in order.
config.hlp_config_llm_provider_order: Providers tried when fallback is on, after the default one.
config.hlp_config_hitl_timer_enabled: When the graph waits for the operator, a timer starts.
config.hlp_config_hitl_default_timer_seconds: Default length of the timer, in seconds.
config.hlp_config_hitl_on_timeout: human: keep waiting. system: the system decides. reject: reject automatically.
config.hlp_config_hitl_level: nodes: graph nodes stop. brain: the Brain asks on protected devices. both: both flows.
config.hlp_config_hitl_brain_critical_targets: Devices for which the Brain always asks for approval.
config.hlp_config_policy_unlisted_devices: reject: nobody can command a device that is not listed. allow: any value is accepted.
config.hlp_config_demo_seed_conflict_at_start: Writes a test conflict event in the database at every start. Leave off in production.
config.hlp_config_prompts_brain_escalation: Role of the model when the Brain decides an escalation. The answer format is added by the code.
config.hlp_config_prompts_brain_escalation_user: Message template. Placeholders: source, target, action, reason, readings, recent_events (in curly braces).
config.hlp_config_prompts_troubleshooting: Role of the model when a device did not run a command: RETRY or ESCALATE.
config.hlp_config_prompts_override: Role of the model that turns an operator OVERRIDE directive into JSON commands.
config.hlp_config_prompts_routine_check: Role of the model in the routine check of the global state.
config.confirm_restart: Restart the application now? Requests in progress are finished, the page becomes unreachable for a few seconds and reconnects by itself.
config.restarting: Restarting… this page reloads when the application is back.
config.restart_timeout: The application did not come back within a minute: start it again by hand (or check the container).
config.restart_unsaved: You have unsaved changes: save or discard them before restarting.
config.hlp_config_signals_window_hours: How far back the signals of the receptors are kept in the state of each run. Older ones are dropped; the numeric ones are also stored in the nervous system.
